description: Use a constrained JSON design-point specification to run Ansys Fluent through the official PyFluent-MCP service.
goal: Improve the configured Fluent report objective by proposing parameter values within the declared engineering bounds.
dataset: An Ansys Fluent case supplied through the FLUENT_CASE_FILE environment variable.
constraints: Only edit design_points values in fluent_experiment.json unless a human explicitly expands the allowlist.
Every value must remain within its parameter minimum and maximum.
Do not insert Python, Fluent TUI commands, file paths, endpoints, or arbitrary code into the experiment file.
A design point is valid only when all report constraints and configured residual thresholds pass.
Use one Fluent solve at a time under the Student license.
fix_direction: Explore bounded design-point values while preserving the declared parameter paths, reports, constraints, and solver safety settings.
